_comment: The Pip (lqe, LANA.cpp) build the client packages at <resources>/pip (electron-pip-supervisor.js), built by scripts/build-pip.sh on a matching computer with LANA.cpp's distribution contract. The v3.0.0 tag was MOVED on 2026-11-12T20:47:52Z from b7debcdd3410 to this commit: Windows build-gate fixes only (MSVC /WX warnings, release gates), all 5 CI jobs green; no new flag or settings key. Earlier moves the same day: bb191effb26c added --gpu-inexact, 8f1970cdd11e the D-41 Metal defaults (adaptive prefill on, 512-row busy chunk), b7debcdd3410 graph reuse and faster batched GPU decode. windows-x64: CI run 43278937570 (head 396ca2c1d643, all 5 jobs green), job windows-shipping, artifact lqe-win32-x64 (zip sha256 423c0d4d76c9..., GitHub's own artifact digest): lqe-win32-x64.exe, whose version.txt and embedded build id say 396ca2c1d643 (built reproducible); placed as build/pip/lqe.exe. The tag name alone cannot tell a build before a move from one after, so scripts/build-pip.sh refuses a checkout whose v3.0.0 resolves to any other commit (fetch with git fetch --tags --force). Change the commit only together with a rebuild of every platform's sha256.

cmakeNotes.macos-x64: Not a LANA.cpp engine-release target at v3.0.0; flags come from its x64 release builds. LQE_DISTRIBUTION=ON and LQE_BUILD_TESTS=ON as in the linux-x64 and windows-x64 jobs of .github/workflows/engine-release.yml (GGML_NATIVE OFF, GGML_LLAMAFILE ON, static libraries are set by CMakeLists.txt). LQE_METAL=OFF: Intel Mac GPUs are not a LANA.cpp target, so this is the CPU backend like the x64 release builds; Accelerate stays on as in every Apple build. GGML_AVX2/FMA/F16C ON and AVX512 OFF: the x86-64-v3 baseline CMakeLists.txt pins for x64 distribution builds but applies only when NOT APPLE, so it is given here (every Mac that runs macOS 13.3 has AVX2). CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=x86_64 states what CMakeLists.txt would detect. The macOS floor is 13.3, forced by CMakeLists.txt for any LQE_DISTRIBUTION Apple build and the same as macos-arm64; Electron 44 runs on macOS 12, so an Intel Mac on macOS 12 gets the app without local Pip. Checked by scripts/verify-pip-macos-x64.js in place of LANA.cpp scripts/verify_release_artifact.py, which accepts only darwin-arm64.

macos-arm64.source: LANA.cpp CI run 43278937570 (head 396ca2c1d643), job macos-shipping (-DLQE_DISTRIBUTION=ON -DLQE_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DLQE_METAL=ON, the macos-arm64 cmake contract above), lqe-darwin-arm64; saved before the GitHub artifact purge to the LANA Azure parts store at macos-arm64/lqe-396ca2c1d643/lqe-darwin-arm64. CI builds are reproducible; a local build embeds its checkout path and gets a different sha256. Placed as build/pip/lqe; electron-builder signs it (mac.binaries).

macos-x64.source: Built natively on the Intel build Mac (x86_64, Apple clang 17.0.0 / Xcode 16.4, cmake 4.3.3, macOS 15.6.1) with scripts/build-pip.sh from a clean LANA.cpp checkout at 396ca2c1d643, the macos-x64 cmake contract above; 28/28 ctest; scripts/verify-pip-macos-x64.js passed (x86_64 only, floor 13.3, links only /usr/lib and /System). Replaces ad6ed844..., a Rosetta build on an Apple Mac whose binary was not kept. A local build embeds its checkout path and toolchain, so another computer gets a different sha256.

windows-x64.source: LANA.cpp CI run 43278937570 (head 396ca2c1d643), job windows-shipping, exe lqe-win32-x64.exe. The GitHub artifact was purged 2026-11-12; the exe is kept unchanged in the LANA Azure parts store at windows-x64/lqe-396ca2c1d643/lqe-win32-x64.exe (sha256 above).

linux-x64.source: LANA.cpp CI run 43278937570 (head 396ca2c1d643), job linux-shipping, lqe-linux-x64; saved before the GitHub artifact purge to the LANA Azure parts store at linux-x64/lqe-396ca2c1d643/lqe-linux-x64. Placed as build/pip/lqe. Imports libvulkan.so.1 (fallback in pip/vulkan-fallback).

vulkanLoader._comment: The Khronos Vulkan loader each platform's package ships in pip/vulkan-fallback, never beside lqe: lqe is built with LQE_VULKAN=ON and needs the loader to start at all, even on the processor, so a computer without one (a Windows VM or server, the basic display driver; a Linux machine without libvulkan1, found on an Azure Ubuntu 24.04 VM) could not start it. A copy beside lqe would win over the computer's own loader (Windows searches an application's folder before System32; Linux lqe has RUNPATH $ORIGIN), so electron-pip-supervisor.js runs lqe --version as it is and only when the loader is missing runs it again with this folder first on PATH (Windows) or LD_LIBRARY_PATH (Linux), then starts the servers with that environment. windows-x64: LunarG Vulkan Runtime components 1.3.296.0, the newest runtime archive LunarG publishes (approved 2026-11-12). linux-x64: the loader from the LunarG Linux SDK 1.4.350.0, the tarball LANA.cpp's CI pins (scripts/install_vulkan_sdk_linux.sh), shipped as libvulkan.so.1 (its SONAME); it needs glibc 2.34 or later. scripts/fetch-vulkan-loader.js takes each at build time only, checks the archive against the sha256 LunarG publishes (sha256Source) and the file against sha256; the app never downloads it.
